report_md:
台灣時間 2026 年 7 月 31 日凌晨 0 時 58 分，台東成功近海（北緯 23.1 度、東經 121.36 度）發生芮氏規模 4.7 的地震，震源深度為 20.2 公里。EdgeQuake 系統進行震後回放模擬，在發震後 4.9 秒完成首次定位，並於發震後 9.2 秒估算首次規模為 5.88，隨後收斂至最終規模 4.81，震央定位誤差為 17.4 公里。

9.2 秒為未納入系統延遲的理論下界，不可與官方發布時間直接比較。由於此地震規模未達 M≥5.0 門檻，災防告警（PWS）並未觸發。依據 WorldPop 2026 R2025A 數據，在假設點源與平均地表條件下，預估約 44040 人可能感受到震度3以上搖晃。此事件與 1980 年 4 月 2 日於玉井東方 95 公里處發生的規模 5.0 地震最為相似。本報告由自動化研究原型系統產出，非官方正式強震即時警報。

---

On July 31, 2026, at 00:58 AM local time, a magnitude 4.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Taitung County (23.1°N, 121.36°E) at a depth of 20.2 km. In this post-hoc replay, the EdgeQuake engine achieved its first location at origin+4.9 s. The first magnitude estimate of 5.88 was resolved at origin+9.2 s, which later stabilized at a final magnitude of 4.81, resulting in an epicenter error of 17.4 km.

The 9.2 s figure is a theoretical lower bound that excludes system latency and must not be compared directly with official issuance times. The public-alert (PWS) gate did not fire because the event magnitude did not meet the M≥5.0 threshold. Based on the WorldPop 2026 R2025A dataset, assuming a point-source and average-site conditions, an estimated ~44040 people may have felt intensity-3+ shaking. This event is seismically most similar to the April 2, 1980 earthquake of magnitude 5.0 located 95 km E of Yujing. This is an automated report from a research prototype, not an official warning.
